injuries.detail: Post is doubtful to return to Monday's game against Toronto due to a head injury.
Pippen (back) won't play in Monday's game versus the Raptors.
Stewart (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Toronto.
Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Quickley (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
Murray-Boyles (illness) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
Barnes (groin) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
Bittle (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against Memphis.
Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
